title: Jim Semivan's bedroom encounter with beings and a guardian

tellings.quote: "I was standing there with my wife and these beings were there and there was somebody behind me.

plain: A man named Jim Semivan is said to have woken to find strange beings in his bedroom while he stood there with his wife, and someone, a kind of guardian, standing behind him. Grant Cameron, a researcher who collects UFO accounts, tells Michels this, quoting Semivan: 'I was standing there with my wife and these beings were there and there was somebody behind me.' If true, the encounter came with a protector figure as well as the visitors.
